title: Spark K8s Cluster Config
description: Routing document injected into consumer GitLab projects as the SPARK_K8S_CONFIG File-type CI/CD variable and resolved at runtime by the spark-k8s-deployer resolver (/scripts/resolve-cluster). A document carries exactly one of two shapes: `clusters`, the cluster shape with a default entry and last-match-wins resolution, or `envs`, one entry per environment resolved by pattern specificity. The format version lives in this schema's $id; a document declares `version` only when a later schema version exists. Source of truth: this file (sf-platform-generator); the copy in spark-k8s-deployer must stay identical.

version.description: Configuration format version. Optional: the resolver treats an absent version as 1. Documents conforming to this schema either omit it or declare 1.

clusters.description: Clusters the project deploys to. Scanned bottom-up at resolution time: the first entry whose refs matches the normalized ref wins (last declared wins, gitignore style); no match falls back to the default entry.

name.description: GKE cluster name, exported as K8S_CLUSTER_NAME.

project_id.description: GCP project ID hosting the cluster, exported as GCP_PROJECT_ID.

location.description: Cluster region or zone, exported as K8S_LOCATION.

dns_endpoint.description: DNS endpoint of the control plane, exported as SPARK_K8S_CLUSTER_DNS_ENDPOINT. May be empty for clusters without one.

use_dns_endpoint.description: Sets K8S_USE_DNS_ENDPOINT. When absent the resolver infers it from the presence of dns_endpoint.

default.description: Marks the fallback cluster used when no refs pattern matches. Exactly one entry carries true.

refs.description: Git ref patterns this cluster owns. Globs by default (* does not cross a slash, ** does; a pattern without a leading refs/ is matched against refs/heads/); a pattern wrapped in slashes is a regular expression. Empty on the default entry.

envs.description: Environments the project deploys to, one entry each, joined with the connection data of the cluster that hosts the environment. Resolved by specificity, never by list order: every pattern of every entry that matches the normalized ref is collected and the most specific wins (a literal beats a glob, a glob beats a regex; between globs more literal characters, then fewer **, then fewer *). Two matches of equal rank from different entries are an error. No match resolves nothing and the deploy skips; there is no default entry.

env.description: Environment name as declared in the project definition.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace of the environment on the cluster, exported as KUBE_NAMESPACE.

name.description: GKE cluster name, exported as K8S_CLUSTER_NAME.

project_id.description: GCP project ID hosting the cluster, exported as GCP_PROJECT_ID.

location.description: Cluster region or zone, exported as K8S_LOCATION.

dns_endpoint.description: DNS endpoint of the control plane, exported as SPARK_K8S_CLUSTER_DNS_ENDPOINT. May be empty for clusters without one.

use_dns_endpoint.description: Sets K8S_USE_DNS_ENDPOINT. When absent the resolver infers it from the presence of dns_endpoint.

refs.description: Git ref patterns this environment claims. Globs by default (* does not cross a slash, ** does, ? is one character, \ escapes; a pattern without a leading refs/ is matched against refs/heads/, tags need the refs/tags/ prefix); a pattern wrapped in slashes is a regular expression. Required; an empty list means the environment never deploys automatically. The catch-all is an explicit ** and ranks lowest.
